name: Toggle
description: Compact choice strip: one radio choice, or independently pressed options with `multiple`.

label.description: Visible name of the value. Empty content leaves naming to aria-label/aria-labelledby.

description.description: Help for entering the value, announced with the focused control.

error.description: Validation message; marks the field invalid unless aria-invalid is explicit. Not a live region.

labelPosition.description: Label above the control, or at its inline start (stacks when narrow). Defaults to top.

items.description: Choices in visual, keyboard and form order; an item with a missing or repeated `value` is skipped.

disabled.description: Disables every choice and leaves the value out of FormData.

orientation.description: Lays the choices out in a row or a column; a single choice answers to all four arrows.

aria-label.description: Names the group when there is no visible label.

aria-labelledby.description: Ids of visible elements that name the group; they take precedence over `label`.

name.description: FormData key; a multiple value submits one entry per choice.

form.description: Id of the form that submits and resets the value, when it is not an ancestor.

required.description: Blocks form submission until a choice is selected and marks the label.

autoFocus.description: Focuses the selected enabled choice, or the first enabled one, on mount.

membrane.description: Shared outer spacing around each choice; toggling it keeps DOM and focus.

multiple.description: Lets the user press any number of choices, and makes the value a `string[]` instead of `string | null`.

value.description: Selected key, or keys with `multiple`; keys missing from `items` select nothing until they appear.

defaultValue.description: Selection on mount, restored by form reset; same shape as `value`.

notes: Toggle is SegmentedControl under its former name: one component, one contract.
